newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine six-,12-mo T-bill yields down, 9-mo up.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine six-,12-mo T-bill yields down, 9-mo up.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six- and 12-month Ukraine discount treasury bills edged down and nine-month yields rose from previous sales, a central bank statement said on Friday.
Six-month bills slipped to 20.69 percent from 21.00 percent, nine-month bills rose to 28.73 percent from 27.91 percent and 12-month bills edged down to 31.68 percent from 32.56 percent.
Results of six-month T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 12.00 million UAH 9.00 million UAH
Amount sold 12.00 million UAH 9.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.88 million UAH 8.15 million UAH
The central bank sold 120,000 T-bills, the bank statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 3.
